items.title: App State Clinches Bowl Eligibility with Breakthrough Win at Marshall
items.summary: HUNTINGTON, W. Va. — App State Football traveled to Marshall needing a victory to clinch bowl eligibility. The Mountaineers are headed home with an emotional win that delivered even more from a historical standpoint.

items.summary: BOONE, N.C. — Two Sun Belt East Division teams with identical records meet Saturday night, with the winner between App State and Marshall clinching bowl eligibility heading into the final two weeks of the regular season.
